description: Find services an agent can use, by what they do: remote MCP servers (with the tools each lists), local MCP servers (packages), pay-per-call APIs (x402, MPP), A2A agents and task marketplaces, with our checks for each. Search by words (query) or by capability tree node (branch); filter on type, access (none_asked, payment, credentials), max_price_usd and the evidence (passing, min_pass_rate); then call get_service for connection details. Results are compact; use limit/offset to page.

access.description: What the service asks of a caller (access/1): 'payment' (our plain request got HTTP 402), 'credentials' (HTTP 401, or its agent card or MCP Registry entry says so) or 'none_asked' (answered without asking for either, and nothing stated says credentials are needed). Services with no value are left out.

branch.description: Capability tree id from get_tree, e.g. 'messaging/email/validation', 'places/weather' or 'places' (a node includes everything under it), or 'other'. Up to three ids separated by commas list services in any of them.

max_median_ms.description: Over the last 30 days of our checks (response-times/1, measured from eastern North America; one operation per service, timeouts counted at the time limit); services with too few checks for the figure are left out. Maximum median response time in milliseconds.

max_p95_ms.description: Over the last 30 days of our checks (response-times/1, measured from eastern North America; one operation per service, timeouts counted at the time limit); services with too few checks for the figure are left out. Maximum 95th-percentile response time in milliseconds.

max_price_usd.description: Maximum price per call in USD stablecoin, where the price is known.

max_terms_changes_90d.description: Only services whose observed x402 payment terms changed at most this many times in the last 90 days (0 = unchanged). Short histories are labelled limited.

min_checks.description: Minimum checks in the last 30 days, to avoid judging on one check.

min_pass_rate.description: Share of checks passed in the last 30 days, 0 to 1.

min_payers.description: Minimum unique payers in 30 days, as reported by the registry.

one_per_provider.description: Return one endpoint per provider (registrable domain): the first under the chosen sort (by default, the evidence order: the share of checks passed, then how long we have watched it).

payment_model.description: 'per_call': it asked for payment for our request (HTTP 402). Services whose payment model is not known are left out.

provider.description: Only endpoints from this provider (registrable domain, e.g. 'example.com'), as given in a result's provider field.

query.description: Text search (search/3) over names, hosts, URLs, operator names, the tool names an MCP server lists, and the name of a service's place in the capability tree when that place passed our three placement checks. Write it as words or a sentence: words about payment or shape rather than purpose (mcp, api, pay, per, call, no, key, ...) are set aside (use the filters for those), and the response's query_words says which words were used. A service matches at least half the words (one of one or two); more matched words rank first, and among services matching as many, those matching the rarer words. A word of three or more characters matches the start of a word, or anywhere inside a name, host or operator word; one of seven or more also matches by its first five characters; a shorter word matches a whole word. E.g. 'weather' or 'translate'.

scope.description: directory (default): services that meet the listing criteria (https://agentservicedirectory.com/methodology#directory); index: everything we watch.

sort.description: Default: relevance when query is given, otherwise evidence. relevance (the default when q is given): first services matching more of the query's words (and, among those matching as many, the rarer words), then those whose provider's domain starts with the first word used (its own site: q=stripe puts stripe.com first), then those whose name is, starts with or contains the words used, then the rest; within each group, the evidence order (evidence/2). evidence (evidence/2, the default without q): first services with at least 5 checks in 30 days, then by the share of those checks passed, then by how long we have watched them (longest first), then by payers as the registry reports them, as a tiebreak only. provider-mix/1: in every sort but name and recent, each provider's results after its first three come after every other provider's first three, so one provider cannot fill a page; provider= (or host=) lists one provider's services in plain order, and group=provider gives one per provider. median_ms and p95_ms: fastest first over 30 days, services without the figure last.

name: search_services
title: Search services
